# Hatch Documentation

> Hatch is a local HTTPS development tool for macOS that provides .test domains with trusted certificates, automatic DNS, and reverse proxying.

## Getting Started
- [What is Hatch?](https://httphatch.com/docs/getting-started/what-is-hatch)
- [Installation](https://httphatch.com/docs/getting-started/installation)
- [Quick Start](https://httphatch.com/docs/getting-started/quick-start)
